confidence_notes: Japan-wide Numbeo prices updated June 2026 provide a baseline; no comparable Nikko price index appeared in the searches. Nikko price guides suggest coffee and casual meals near that baseline. Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical price relationship to local draft beer because representative glass prices were unavailable. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from the supplied city comparisons, not live booking prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Nikko's tourism demand and limited overnight supply may put accommodation somewhat above Nara and Sapporo, while its smaller market suggests prices below Kyoto overall. Estimates allow for substantial seasonal variation.
